name: @pipeworx/mcp-macau-amcm

tools.name: macau_fx_rates
tools.description: Daily interbank mid exchange rates for the Macau pataca (MOP / 澳門元) against ~17 currencies (USD, HKD, CNY, EUR, GBP, JPY, KRW, SGD, TWD, AUD, CHF and more), from AMCM, the Monetary Authority of Macao (澳門金融管理局). Returns one dated row per currency per Macau business day with `mop_per_unit` (MOP per unit — the headline rate; MOP is pegged to HKD at ~1.03) and the currency's own conventional `market_quote`. Defaults to the last 7 days ending on the most recent published date; pass `begin`/`end` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to ~1 year per call) for history and `currency` (e.g. "CNY" or "USD,HKD,CNY") to filter. Answers "MOP to USD exchange rate", "Macau pataca vs RMB last week", "澳門元匯率".

begin.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYYMMDD). Default: 6 days before `end`.

end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: AMCM's most recent published date.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code(s) to filter, comma-separated, e.g. "CNY" or "USD,HKD,EUR".

tools.name: macau_monia
tools.description: MONIA — the MOP Overnight Index Average (澳門元隔夜平均指數), Macau's overnight interbank reference rate in percent, published each Macau business day by AMCM, the Monetary Authority of Macao. The MOP equivalent of SOFR/HONIA for pricing pataca-denominated instruments. Defaults to the last 7 days ending on the most recent fixing; pass `begin`/`end` (YYYY-MM-DD, up to ~1 year per call) for history. Answers "Macau overnight interbank rate", "MONIA rate today", "MOP reference rate history".

begin.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYYMMDD). Default: 6 days before `end`.

end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the most recent MONIA fixing date.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-macau-amcm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the macau-amcm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
